Section: section_1 — From ODEs to PDEs: A Visual Shift

Lecture lines:
ODEs track change in one variable.
PDEs model change in many variables.
Think of space and time together.
Bouncing ball follows an ODE.
Vibrating drums follow a PDE.

Planned animations:
Create a single point representing an ODE solution.
Expand the point into a dynamic wave pattern to represent a PDE.
Morph the wave pattern into a 2D surface.
Label the surface axes as #FFFFFF.
Highlight the transition point between 1D and 2D.

Section: section_2 — Core Concept: The Heat Equation

Lecture lines:
Heat moves from hot to cold.
Diffusion describes this spreading process.
Curvature drives the heat flow.

Planned animations:
Display the heat equation formula in #FF5733.
Animate particles moving from high concentration to low concentration.
Demonstrate smoothing of a jagged line into a smooth curve.

Section: section_3 — The Wave Equation: Nature's Rhythm

Lecture lines:
Waves propagate through a medium.
Acceleration defines the wave's shape.
Tension keeps the rhythm steady.

Planned animations:
Display the wave equation formula in #33FF57.
Show a vibrating string with fixed endpoints at #FFFFFF.
Visualize the propagation of a peak along the string.

Section: section_4 — Boundary and Initial Conditions

Lecture lines:
Equations need rules to function.
Initial conditions set the start.
Boundary conditions define the edges.

Planned animations:
Show a grid representing the spatial domain.
Highlight boundary edges in #3357FF.
Show the initial state wave as an input to the PDE.

Section: section_5 — Real-World Applications

Lecture lines:
PDEs explain complex real-world physics.
Fluids follow these intricate laws.
Nature obeys these elegant models.

Planned animations:
Show a simulation of heat diffusing through a metal plate.
Display fluid flow around a wing shape.
Fade in real-world images of these phenomena.

        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")

                y = 2.2 - i * 1
